attributes.action: Individuals with Learning disabilities and Cancer diagnosis
attributes.additional_details:
It should be made law that those with learning disabilities have someone with them when being given a cancer diagnosis.

This could be a carer/representative/ professional. They need to be with them when they are given a cancer diagnosis due to this being a highly vulnerable group in society, their rates of survival being low, understanding issues, late diagnosis/misdiagnosis/diagnostic overshadowing.

They experience a shorter life expectancy and face significant health inequities.
attributes.background: I would like UK government to make it compulsory for those who have a learning disability to have someone with them eg carer/representative when they are given a cancer diagnosis; this is a highly vulnerable group in society, their rates of survival are low. They have shorter life expectancy.

rejection.details: It is already possible to bring someone along with you to medical appointments. We are therefore unclear about the action that this petition is seeking.
